title: A carried rule's validated span applies to a dive in a plane never sampled
description: A later encounter around a new body in the inverse-2.5 world. The exponent rule was validated earlier over 0.6-1.4 r0. One 24 h arc has been tracked (1.05-1.15 r0) in one orbit plane. The plan dives below 0.6 r0 and changes plane by 25 deg. Validated spans and the calibration profile are distances only, so they apply in the new plane; three forecasts from the same data show the earned hedge inside the span and the default beyond it.
units: SI: m, s, m/s, m/s^2, rad. A fix is [azimuth, elevation(, range)] of the inertial direction ship -> target: azimuth = atan2(d_y, d_x) in (-pi, pi], elevation = asin(d_z / |d|). sigma is per component; sigma_az carries the 1 / cos(elevation) of an isotropic pointing error. Attitudes are unit quaternions [w, x, y, z], body to inertial. Accelerometer samples are [f_x, f_y, f_z] in the body frame.
frame: Right-handed inertial. Gauge: body A at the origin and at rest at t = 0 of every attempt (spec 3.4). Body frame: +x forward, +y left, +z up.

propagation.note: Reference setting; all times are multiples of dt. Any propagator whose position error over the arc is below ~1 m reproduces the expected values.

tolerance.numeric: Fits with compare = numeric: |x_impl - x_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref per parameter; |sigma_impl / sigma_ref - 1| <= 0.05; |chi2_impl / chi2_ref - 1| <= 0.02; |rho_impl - rho_ref| <= 0.02. Tier L windows: same boundaries (t0, t1, nFixes) and |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref. Profile nodes: |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.1 sigma_ref.
tolerance.qualitative: Fits with compare = qualitative are grossly misfitted (chi2/nu > 25) or unconverged; only the inequalities in `checks` and any heldOut.pass value are required.
tolerance.physicalClaims: Per check, stated in `checks`. The generator refuses to write a vector whose claims fail.

notes: Expected values: the `carried-rule` forecast (and its Tier L and anchor). The other two forecasts are contrasts that the checks use. Tolerance as in forecast-envelope-3d.
The new body's local gravity scale is measured by Tier L inside the sampled distances, so its mass prior does not enter the forecast.
`truth` blocks are for checking only and must never reach the estimator (P11). Measurements whose target is not a modelled body are ignored by that fit.
Covariances of positions are [xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz].

attempts.note: First arc in a later encounter around a new body (mu = 6e9): coasting between 1.05 and 1.15 r0 in a plane inclined 30 deg, holding one attitude (the `q` on its fixes); data up to now (24 h), fixes every 180 s.

validated.recordedOn: body A of the earlier encounter

carried.source: values as produced by the planar extension-validation / distance-law, rounded; a validated span is distances only

plan.description: Burn of 120 s at 0.2674 m/s^2 now: 13.8 m/s retrograde combined with a 25 deg plane change, then coast. The path leaves the sampled distances and the sampled plane, crosses the validated range and drops below it.
